resolved_conflicts.explanation: tnlandforms calls the tower Jefferson City and OpenStreetMap calls it Flat Gap Firetower; coordinates match within about 30 m, so treated as one tower. The NHLR Mooresburg (Flat Gap) lookout is a separate Hawkins County tower.

notes_for_editor: Only a state number, a county list entry, an OpenStreetMap tag set and a compiler's status line were found for this tower. No build date, designer, staffing, fire, access or visit record. Status standing is from tnlandforms with no date; the page does not date its standing or removed marks. The nomination's table of towers extant as of March 26, 2014 also lists Jefferson City. Naming confusion: the name Flat Gap also belongs to the NHLR Mooresburg lookout in Hawkins County (US 990), which the story keeps separate. Record name and county are consistent with sources; no correction proposed.
